'''Thrasher''' was the name of a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Reek/Legends|reek]] who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Darvannis]] around [[3638 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Thrasher appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as a boss in the "Scum and Villainy" operation.
